title: GraphSmith approver attestation (register Lane A)
description: Records WHO approved WHAT, bound by a detached signature over the assure-packet hash. C1-binding: approver identity and timestamps are EVIDENCE, recorded and verified, and MUST NOT be a decision input to any pass/fail path (mirrors adoption-entry.human.ts). Frozen Wave 0 (v0.3.0).

approver_id.description: Stable identity of the approver (evidence, not a routing input).

role.description: Role the approval was made under (e.g. release-owner, compliance-officer).

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact artifact (assure packet) approved.

obligation_set_id.description: Identifier of the obligation set (Lane B) this approval covers.

attested_at.description: Timestamp of attestation. EVIDENCE ONLY (C1) — never a decision input. Optional; absence is not a failure.

signature.description: Detached signature over the assure-packet SHA-256 (reuses the hash assure.js already computes).

signer.description: Key identifier; trust of the signer is verifier policy, not a GraphSmith guarantee.
